claims.text: The global pharmaceutical drug delivery market is forecasted to grow to USD 2546.0 billion by 2029.
The Rule of Five (Ro5) principles for AI in formulation development require a formulation dataset containing at least 500 entries.
The Rule of Five (Ro5) principles require coverage of a minimum of 10 drugs and all significant excipients.
The Rule of Five (Ro5) principles require appropriate molecular representations for both drugs and excipients.
The Rule of Five (Ro5) principles require inclusion of all critical process parameters.
The Rule of Five (Ro5) principles require utilization of suitable algorithms and model interpretability.

methodologies.name: Rule of Five (Ro5) principles for AI formulation development
methodologies.description: A set of five criteria guiding dataset size, drug and excipient coverage, molecular representation, process parameters, and algorithm interpretability to enhance AI reliability in drug delivery.
